journeys.name: Discover and install
journeys.conditions: Open localized home/download pages on mobile and desktop; stable/nightly release selection, API unavailable, reduced motion, keyboard-only and no app runtime.
journeys.acceptance: Time to readable useful content and correct download action; correct OS/architecture/store, locale/SEO links and graceful release lookup fallback. Measure total transfer and main-thread work, not just WASM render time.

journeys.name: First native desktop launch
journeys.conditions: Clean profile and migrated mature profile; local or remote-only mode; provider installed/missing; authenticated/unpaired; preview not yet opened.
journeys.acceptance: Launch-to-window, launch-to-interactive composer, authoritative workspace ready; process count, peak/retained RSS and startup CPU. Keep cached paint separate from usable authenticated state.

journeys.name: First browser session
journeys.conditions: Hosted app, local server and guest link; browser cache cold/warm; slow CPU/network; auth callback and deep link.
journeys.acceptance: Time to useful and interactive page, asset bytes, parse/compile work, pairing/account correctness, route restoration. A native desktop result cannot substitute for web acceptance.

journeys.name: Type and compose under load
journeys.conditions: Several streaming threads; 120k-character draft where supported; CJK marked text, emoji/combining marks, mixed direction, rich chips and suggestions.
journeys.acceptance: Key/composition-to-paint p50/p95/p99 and longest stall; caret, selection, exact Markdown source, undo and accessibility parity. No accidental send during composition.

journeys.name: Rich paste and file drop
journeys.conditions: Small/large text, multi-image paste, custom-reference MIME, cross-environment thread reference, native folder drop, app share/camera input.
journeys.acceptance: Time to editable/visible result and retained bytes; preserve source/context identity, upload progress, size limits and folder-versus-file semantics. Typing must remain responsive.

journeys.name: Stream and scroll a long conversation
journeys.conditions: Long code, math, tables, Mermaid, citations, huge single messages, growing last block, history folded/unfolded; user reads old messages while new data arrives.
journeys.acceptance: Arrival-to-visible text, frame-time tails, scroll-anchor error, CPU and allocations; no forced follow-end, duplicated rows, incorrect source offsets or stale selection.

journeys.name: Switch and return to work
journeys.conditions: Many threads/environments, draft-to-thread transition, modal/settings overlays, native navigation back, reconnect with a catch-up burst.
journeys.acceptance: Time to stable visible destination and interactive editor; preserve draft, selection, scroll, route and focus; bounded mount/layout/update counts. Do not step through obsolete catch-up states.

journeys.name: Review a large diff
journeys.conditions: Many small files, a giant file/line, Unicode/tabs, split/unified view, expand/collapse, file filter, find and comment while changes arrive.
journeys.acceptance: First useful viewport, scroll/jump/search latency, frame tails and memory; line/anchor correctness, viewed state and cancellation. Preserve existing worker and native-layout advantages.

journeys.name: Edit and save a file
journeys.conditions: Large file, rapid changes, save echoed from server, external change, grant revoked, remote environment or readonly external file.
journeys.acceptance: Edit-to-paint and save-to-confirmation; no editor reset on an echo, correct conflict/readonly outcome, retained unsaved edits and stable selection.

journeys.name: Run Git and worktree actions
journeys.conditions: Create/switch isolated task, multi-repo project, branch picker, commit/review, external editor, status changes while view remains open.
journeys.acceptance: Click-to-usable status and operation completion, process count and filesystem work; same safety, worktree ownership and error/confirmation behavior. Measure warm unchanged refs separately.

journeys.name: Complete PR/issue review
journeys.conditions: Cached and uncached list, intent prefetch, comments/review drafts, labels/reactions, guide and checks, offline return; each supported host capability.
journeys.acceptance: Time to usable content and immediate mutation feedback, authoritative completion and rollback; correct host/account routing and no duplicate uncertain action.

journeys.name: Interactive terminal during contention
journeys.conditions: PTY output bursts, full-screen app, large retained history, chat/diff/media activity, keyboard/mouse/IME, resize/DPI, selection/copy.
journeys.acceptance: Input-to-echo and output-to-pixels p50/p95/p99, frames/CPU/RSS and protocol correctness. Preserve terminal mode, query reply routing and alternative screen behavior.

journeys.name: Reconnect and recover terminal
journeys.conditions: Slow link, missing/stopped terminal, server restart, disconnect inside multibyte/control sequence, partial native write rejection.
journeys.acceptance: Attach-to-correct-screen, bytes, recovery time and replay count; exact bounded output/order and no spinning retry, corrupted parser state or unintended shell restart.

journeys.name: Open and search media/documents
journeys.conditions: PDF many pages/large text, images/HEIC/TIFF where supported, audio/video, archives, CSV/TSV, Office and SQLite attachment.
journeys.acceptance: Time to first page/frame/table and first search hit, decode CPU/peak RSS; bounded fetch/cache, format limits, cancellation and correct readonly source behavior. Total scan completion is separate.

journeys.name: Dictate into an existing draft
journeys.conditions: On-device and selected environment/cloud paths; microphone denial/loss, app background, concurrent editing, cancel/cleanup and failed destination.
journeys.acceptance: Capture-start and stop-to-editable-transcript latency, energy, draft preservation and explicit destination/consent. No automatic send or silent fallback host.

journeys.name: Capture and attach SnapShot
journeys.conditions: Global shortcut from another app, permission allowed/denied, capture cancellation, several workspaces, text/image capture paths.
journeys.acceptance: Shortcut-to-overlay, capture-to-ready-context and focus restoration; correct target workspace, privacy and clipboard semantics. Detailed native capture parity needs separate validation.

journeys.name: Use browser preview
journeys.conditions: Local and remote environments, streamed tab and local remote-loopback rendering, mobile WebView, take/release control, file picker/download/popups, network loss.
journeys.acceptance: Input-to-visible-page response, frame latency/bitrate, CPU/RSS/energy; exact origin/tunnel/storage and ownership behavior. Only intended visible streams run; browser engine startup is included.

journeys.name: Use an HTML reply or MCP App
journeys.conditions: Scripted chart/form, theme change, resize/fullscreen, tool invocation requiring approval, message posting, navigation and malicious/untrusted resource attempts.
journeys.acceptance: Time to interactive widget and tool round trip; sandbox, scoped app bridge, user-gesture rules and state lifecycle. Static screenshots or disabled scripting do not satisfy parity.

journeys.name: Control a simulator or device
journeys.conditions: iOS/Android supported devices; discover/setup, stream touch/keyboard, screenshot/recording, visible/background/PIP, agent permission denied.
journeys.acceptance: Discovery-to-useful-preview and input-to-frame; steady CPU/energy/bitrate, correct visible-session and permission ownership. Closing preview must have the same device-lifetime effect.

journeys.name: Use mobile offline and rotate/fold
journeys.conditions: Restart offline with cached work, queued drafts/files, phone/tablet/fold, keyboard attach/detach, orientation, low-memory recreation.
journeys.acceptance: Time to useful offline screen, navigation/scroll stability, retained drafts and convergence on reconnect. Measure native allocations and retained invisible views.

journeys.name: Receive background activity and return
journeys.conditions: Push completion/failure/approval, foreground silence, notification tap, widget/live activity update, account signout/removal, OS process death.
journeys.acceptance: Delivery-to-visible alert and tap-to-correct-thread, energy/background network; correct permissions, account scope, widget expiry and no live connection requirement added.

journeys.name: Navigate with accessibility tools
journeys.conditions: Keyboard-only F6/Shift-F6, browser modifier variant, roving lists, dialogs/palette/model picker; VoiceOver/TalkBack/native screen readers, reduced motion and text scaling.
journeys.acceptance: Correct focus order/return, labels/actions/selection and shortcuts without interception conflicts; interaction latency and readable layout. Rendering speed cannot excuse missing semantics.

journeys.name: Change locale, theme and settings
journeys.conditions: Large settings/provider lists, appearance/locale changes, theme import, policy-locked choices, reconnect or server settings update while editor open.
journeys.acceptance: Visible change and interactive latency, stable forms/caches, correct scoped settings and locks. Font shaping, contrast and native theme consistency remain acceptance requirements.

journeys.name: Automate through CLI
journeys.conditions: Piped stdin '-', JSON/token-only output, --wait success/failure/needs-input, slow provider, TTY/non-TTY/NO_COLOR, SSH device login, interrupted command.
journeys.acceptance: Process-start-to-result and running-server RPC latency, valid uncontaminated stdout, documented exit statuses and progress on correct stream. Capture child/signal behavior before reproducing it.

journeys.name: Install/update/uninstall every owned package
journeys.conditions: Supported desktop OS/architecture, standalone CLI, WSL, package-manager ownership, mobile store/test builds; interrupted download, signature/checksum error, unrelated existing t3 command.
journeys.acceptance: Verified install/update-to-ready, download/extract bytes, downtime and recovery; preserve state/credentials, launcher ownership, platform signing, safe rollback and documented uninstall scope.

journeys.name: Return from auth or a shared link
journeys.conditions: Desktop/browser/mobile OAuth and passkey callbacks, CLI headless device flow, thread/guest links, expired/revoked link, unknown environment.
journeys.acceptance: Time to authorized correct destination, no trust/confused-host regression, recoverable errors, no duplicate onboarding or lost queued draft. Separate external IdP latency from T3-owned overhead.

journeys.name: Complete a cross-device working day
journeys.conditions: Discover/install → link host → code/terminal/PR → move to phone offline → receive approval → reconnect → preview/voice → update/reopen, with large aged state.
journeys.acceptance: Weighted task completion, worst-tail interaction, total CPU/RSS/network/storage/energy and recovery. Report every journey separately; aggregate improvement cannot hide a broken capability.
